title: The Washing of Regeneration
definition: The Washing of Regeneration is the cleansing work of God by the Holy Spirit through which sinners are renewed in salvation.
summary: The Washing of Regeneration points to the cleansing and renewing work of the Spirit in salvation.
christFocus: Jesus Christ pours out the Spirit and grants cleansing to those saved by mercy.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The washing of regeneration speaks of the cleansing and renewal God gives by the Holy Spirit. Scripture describes salvation as more than a legal change; it includes inward renewal and cleansing from defilement.

This washing does not come from self-improvement or outward ritual alone. It is God's merciful work, making the sinner clean and alive through Christ.

Jesus provides the mercy by which the Spirit renews. The washing of regeneration points to salvation as cleansing, rebirth, and new beginning in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many feel stained by sin, shame, addiction, or past failure. This doctrine declares that God's mercy reaches deeper than the dirt people carry and gives real renewal, not cosmetic religion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring uncleanness and shame to Christ instead of hiding them. Thank God for cleansing mercy, and walk in newness by the Spirit rather than returning to the identity of your past.
